name: tanuki™ / PyFDEM
description: The first parallel, high-performance, pure-Python combined finite-discrete element (FDEM) code; showcased at ECCOMAS and USNCCM and used in the £10M ARIA Re-thickening Arctic Sea Ice project to simulate sea ice dynamics.

name: Firedrake
description: Differentiable programming across the PDE/machine-learning barrier: hybrid ML/physics simulation capabilities and the FEML operator-learning framework for missing-physics discovery, built on Firedrake's finite element abstractions.

name: Fireshape
description: Extended the open-source PDE-constrained shape optimisation toolbox with industrially relevant shell and plate mechanics test cases.
